name: video
description: A 4 to 5 minute video of the demo: the BxLens bar first, then the console, then the scenarios. The voice and the music are made with [bx-audio](https://bxaudio.boxlang.io) (a Piper voice and the synthwave piece). The screen is recorded in a headless browser, so the same video can be built again after the demo or the narration changes.
